A28-3-intro.quote: Schedule 1 sets out the subject matter and duration of the processing

A28-3-a.quote: only on documented instructions from the Client, including in relation to transfers of personal data to a third country

A28-3-a2.quote: If the Supplier believes that an instruction from the Client infringes the GDPR

A28-3-c.quote: technical and organisational measures described in Schedule 2

A28-2.quote: general written authorisation to use the sub-processors listed in Schedule 3

A28-3-d.quote: only under the conditions in this Section 4

A28-4.quote: will impose the same data protection obligations as in these Terms by written contract

A28-3-g.quote: return or delete all personal data and delete existing copies

defects.description: No confidentiality commitment for persons authorised to process.
No assistance with data subject requests.
No assistance with Articles 32 to 36 (security, breach notification, DPIA, prior consultation). A breach notice clause exists, but it is the processor's own duty, not assistance.
No audit clause; the word "inspection" appears only for a building fire-safety inspection.
mustContain: annual inspection by the building owner
